section: Updated Autumn / Winter guide · More Outfit Combinations (Quick Ideas)

entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Make one polished photorealistic full-body men's outfit portrait for the Fit Picker wardrobe app, in a vertical 2:3 frame. One East Asian adult male fashion model with short dark hair, natural proportions and a calm expression. Use a warm off-white seamless studio backdrop and soft natural studio light, with the entire figure centered and visible from head to soles, low visual clutter, subtle contact shadow. Show garments clearly and faithfully, in relaxed contemporary Japanese casual styling. No captions, borders, collages, bags or extra accessories. The wardrobe guide is a garment reference only; ignore the text/layout and other outfits. Use the first combination in the bottom-right ‘More Outfit Combinations’ row: a plain deep navy crewneck sweatshirt, straight through the body with ribbed cuffs and hem, light ivory-white relaxed barrel-leg trousers with natural taper, and white low-top trainers with three black stripes. No coat, no undershirt sticking out.
